thread:
jules: heads-up: planning a mid-window quick rollout for api/runtime/router v2.3.1 — aiming for a 15m slice with canary then ramp. will pin router->runtime compat to r2.3.1-compat. Hoping to start at +15m. Anyone object?

deploy-bot: scheduled: canary 5% for 10m -> 50% for 10m -> full, window 1705004436-1705005336. Canary shards: shard-a, shard-c.

samir: @jules what are rollback gates? do we stop on 5xx rate increase or latency p90 bump?

jules: primary rollback: spike in 5xx > 0.5% above baseline OR p90 latency > 200ms above baseline for >3m. secondary: error regression on key prompt set (QA run).

maria: console team: UI header split change in this deploy? I saw a note about header-toggle. Need to know if console needs a feature-flag flip.

jules: not for this slice — header-toggle deferred. Console only needs the new routing-metadata field handled gracefully (backcompat present). Maria please run a quick smoke on a couple routes when canary starts.

alex: runtime note: we enabled kernel-batching v3 flagged behind env var KERNEL_BATCH=on in canary. If we see KV eviction churn increase, flip env off and rollback. Logs: /var/log/runtime/batching.log (we'll stream).

samir: will monitor infra metrics and add burn-in scorecard to deploy-bot. Also adding an extra latency probe targeting long-seq requests.

maria: ack, will run smoke and check console logs for missing routing-metadata keys.

deploy-bot: canary started (5%) on shard-a at 1705004436. health checks passing. streaming: https://deploys.internal/1705004321/canary

jeff (observability): rolling up watchlist: p50/p90/p99 latency, 5xx rate, kv-evict-rate, routing-errors. Will post alerts to #eng-oncall.

samir: seeing small p90 blip +30ms on canary, within tolerance. kv-evict no change.

deploy-bot: canary -> ramping to 50% at 1705004496 per schedule.

alex: temporary note: if we hit eviction noisy neighbor, set KERNEL_BATCH=off for shard-c via runtime flag: `kubectl set env deploy/runtime KERNEL_BATCH=off -n prod --record` and notify.

maria: console smoke: routing-metadata present for 99/100 checks, one missing due to older proxy. Patching proxy now.

samir: proxy patch staged, will roll to 30% within 5m.

jules: decision: continue ramp if no >0.5% 5xx delta and p90 under threshold. On console missing metadata, if fixes don't hit within 10m hold ramp and run rollback plan.

deploy-bot: ramp complete: 50% at 1705004499. No alerts yet.

jeff (observability): all watch metrics green so far, p99 steady. posting runbook link: https://wiki/internal/release-runbooks/quick-slice

maria: proxy patch looks good at 30%, metadata now consistent. continuing to monitor.

samir: thumbs-up from infra, no eviction churn.

jules: thanks all — continuing to full rollout per schedule in 20m, will keep this thread for rollback/notes. Please ping in thread if you see anything odd. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: note: at any point use `/deploy rollback 1705004321` to trigger automated rollback and unpin routing to previous variant.
